# UC-LOGIN — PingOne login (OIDC + PKCE)

**Track:** demo  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T3 · Sections: §4.1.1

## Buyer Story

Before an agent can act for someone, that person has to prove who they are — and the browser should never hold the tokens.

## PingOne Solution

PingOne authenticates the person with OIDC authorization code + PKCE; the BFF keeps the tokens server-side and gives the browser only a session cookie.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/login-flow","label":"Open the PingOne login flow"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `PERMIT`

## What to Say

> Sign in with PingOne. The browser gets a session cookie; the access token never leaves the BFF.
